gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Synology DS225+ and DS425+ (the only sub-$500 Synology Plus units) do hardware transcoding only after an unsupported kernel-module swap that must be re-applied at every boot, while the UGREEN DXP2800 and TerraMaster F2-425 Plus do it on stock firmware, nor that the J4125 in those Synology units has 12 graphics execution units against 24 in the N100, N150 and N5105.
standout_why: Starry Hope (read 2026-11-08) covers Docker-on-UGREEN, the TOS 7 Plex-package gap, Kaby Lake+ tone mapping and Plex Pass pricing, but never names the DS225+/DS425+ problem. Terabytewise lists the DS225+ at $420.86 with 'Quick Sync: yes' and only says to 'confirm firmware still exposes the iGPU'. NAS Decoded recommends the DS225+ outright for 'hardware H.264/H.265 transcoding'. None of the three gives execution-unit counts or a stock-vs-script column; two of them recommend a unit whose maker's support told a user hardware transcoding 'is not supported on these two models'.
decides: Confirms the UGREEN DXP2800 (and F2-425 Plus) as picks and removes every sub-$500 Synology from the shortlist for this question: the DS225+ is the cheapest Intel Synology but needs 007revad's Transcode_for_x25 script or a manual rmmod/insmod of 11 modified modules via Task Scheduler after every reboot, rebuilt per DSM version. The normalised iGPU table also shows the J4125 (12 EU, 2019) is half the engine of the N100/N150 (24 EU) even when the hack works. Caveat for the page: UGREEN's path is Docker with /dev/dri bind-mounted (Plex calls this 'advanced'), and Plex still publishes no TOS 7 package for TerraMaster, so TerraMaster's native-app claim needs the TOS version checked.

findings.label: Hardware HDR-to-SDR tone mapping requirement (Linux, Docker, NAS)
findings.value: Intel Kaby Lake or newer + Plex Media Server 1.29.2 or newer
findings.source_title: HDR to SDR tone mapping | Plex Support
findings.note: Same Kaby-Lake-or-newer rule applies to the generic NAS row. All candidate Intel chips (J4125 Gemini Lake, N5095/N5105 Jasper Lake, N100 Alder Lake-N, N150 Twin Lake) are newer than Kaby Lake, so tone mapping is gated by the OS exposing the iGPU, not by the chip. Plex warns software tone mapping of 4K 'may struggle in real-time'.

findings.label: Hardware-accelerated streaming prerequisites
findings.value: Active Plex Pass; Docker requires the Quick Sync device bind-mounted into the container; HEVC output on NAS requires Jasper Lake or better
findings.note: Plex calls the Docker device mount 'an advanced feature that requires extra container configuration'. Virtual machines are not supported. HEVC encoding needs PMS 1.41.3+. Gemini Lake J4125 therefore cannot output HEVC even where it transcodes.

findings.label: Plex Media Server NAS packages published (manifest)
findings.value: PMS 1.43.5.11079, released 2026-10-23: Synology DSM 6 / 7 / 7.2.2+, QNAP, ASUSTOR, TerraMaster TOS 4 and TOS 5 & 6, Netgear, Unraid, Thecus, Seagate, WD; no TOS 7 build; no UGREEN entry
findings.note: This is the machine-readable list behind plex.tv/media-server-downloads. UGREEN UGOS Pro has no native package, so Plex runs in Docker. TerraMaster units shipping TOS 7 have no Plex package from Plex; TerraMaster's own claim of a native Plex app on the F2-425 Plus could not be read today (store returned HTTP 429).

findings.label: Stock firmware hardware transcoding
findings.value: Not working on stock DSM; Synology support: 'hardware transcoding is not supported on these two models' (DS225+, DS425+)
findings.source_title: Unlocking PLEX HW transcoding on x25 Synology models, Luka Manestar, Blackvoid
findings.note: Published 23 Sep 2025, updated 1 Feb, 16 Apr, 22 Apr and 15 Jul 2026. Stock i915.ko 'does not trigger HW transcoding as it should'. Workaround: SSH as root, rmmod i915, drm_kms_helper, drm, insmod 11 modified .ko files (v3 package), repeat after every reboot via Task Scheduler, or use Dave Russell's 007revad/Transcode_for_x25 script. Packages are compiled per DSM version (7.2, 7.3, 7.4, kernel 5.10) and must be refreshed when DSM changes. Author labels it 'unofficial and unsupported by Synology'.

findings.label: Plex engineer's diagnosis of the x25 transcoding failure
findings.value: Thread opened 2025-07-16; ChuckPa (Plex) on 2025-07-30: 'We need to figure out if this is a DSM firmware bug with the new DSx25+ or if Synology has deliberately changed something'; logs show 'failed setup for format vaapi: hwaccel initialisation returned error'
findings.source_title: Synology DS425+ hardware transcoding issue, Plex Forums
findings.note: PMS 1.41.9.9961 at the time. Same user reported the same Plex Pass worked on DS423+ and DS1520+ (same J4125 family, older kernel). ChuckPa: 'It is very likely a kernel driver problem.'
